consequence.statement: According to the computed schema diff, v1 HelmChart objects that set status.artifact without status.artifact.digest are rejected by the API server's CRD validation.
consequence.remediation: Make sure any tooling that writes HelmChart status, or restores it from a backup, fills in status.artifact.digest. The status is normally written by the source controller.

assertion.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 HelmChart CRD schema now requires status.artifact.digest, so HelmChart objects with a status.artifact that omits the digest are rejected.
